features.featureTitle: In the Single Comment Generator section within the User View tab (frontend/src/views/UserView.tsx), remove the App/Event dropdown selector entirely. The user should go directly to the 'Select Comment List' dropdown without first choosing an app/event. Since the Comment List dropdown was previously filtered by the selected app/event, it must now show all unlocked comment lists from all apps/events. All other functionality (available count display, device lock notice, Generate Single Comment button, copy output, out-of-comments badge) must remain unchanged. Do not remove or modify App/Event selectors in any other tab or section.
